question: Can a +/-0.005m/s common reference AFTER first received C1 manifold change wheel/body response before remaining contact and improve nominal tracking?
scientific_scope: Oracle post-manifold tracking/authority in fixed6mm only; no loaded-contact, slip, impact-risk, TD3, DR or hardware claim

fixed.before_trigger: B0 zero residual in ALL arms; no precontact scheduled compensation
fixed.after_withdrawal: zero residual; preserve source-zero priority, shaping and actuator limits
fixed.reward: unchanged diagnostic only; no actor/optimizer loaded

measurement.primary: GT-header integral squared body velocity error against independent nominal shaped reference
measurement.window: own first C1 source manifold tc through tc+3s, exclusive endpoint
measurement.native: keep 100ms task/nominal replay separate; same direction required, never merge metrics
measurement.integration: sum(error^2 * actual supported dt); no future interpolation or invented samples
measurement.support: each window boundary and causal nominal needed; no unsupported extrapolation; >=98% supported duration, max GT gap<=40ms
secondary: post-ramp L/R target then L/R actual wheel
body delta/response interval relative to first DRIVE-wheel C1 manifold; report intervening caster contacts separately
sampled body-Z acceleration RMS; NOT force/impulse/damage
measurement.contact: C1 manifold per component; loaded force explicitly unavailable in inherited backend
measurement.clocks: contact/GT/driver source sim time + callback monotonic + decision sim/monotonic; never infer receipt causality from header alone

decision_rules.scope: proposed research screen, not factory requirements or safety tolerances
decision_rules.preintervention_window: last0.5s before own first C1; also report full approach and caster audit
decision_rules.wheel_difference: both wheels same sign as accepted common; source-timed observed intervals
decision_rules.useful_timing: body contrast observed wholly before first DRIVE-wheel C1 manifold; intervening caster contact is reported but not the timing deadline; overlap/missing => unknown; first contact already drive => no remaining horizon for this claim
decision_rules.estimand: each sign/stop separately: equal mean of two within-block candidate/B0 ratios minus1; retain absolute differences and BOTH block signs; zero B0 denominator => unknown
decision_rules.go: >=5% primary reduction BOTH blocks/BOTH stops/BOTH GT grids and native same direction, useful wheel/body contrast plus all task/path/stop constraints; nomination for classical confirmation only
decision_rules.no_go: valid comparable data but no useful authority, no consistent primary gain or constraint failure: keep classical in this envelope; not a claim that every speed/action is impossible
decision_rules.unknown: approach caliper, missing trigger/phase/coverage, causality clock or grid/block inconsistency; close at fixed budget, no automatic repeat or sample expansion
decision_rules.correction: at most ONE software/measurement correction with cause recorded; stop current release, preserve consumed/failed slots, separate version/release required; never refill slots
decision_rules.learning: no training release from this protocol; need value beyond fixed classical schedule and independent validation/test bank

runtime_prerequisites: Isolated E2 adapter/runner + identity, no common103 checkpoint loading or parent ABI mutation
Oracle is outside deployable observation packet; explicit zero-arm trigger and no-trigger handling
Decision monotonic cutoff and causal event eligibility emitted; old E1 trace lacks this proof
Use inherited reliable independent joint/GT and command/limit/cadence/readback checks; no B0-only PI wrapper for nonzero actions
Offline parity, failure injection and source/install pins; choose and freeze full contract before release
First neutral slot is included integration; cannot add smoke/retry; review each slot
Disk preflight/owned processes/timeout/closure ledger and explicit allocation remain necessary
limitations: Manifold is not loaded contact; first impact may precede any effect
All arms use first C1 oracle, so this is not sensor-only governor evidence
B0 precontact differs from E1 classical scheduled precontact: do not pool E1 as this control
Fresh-launch requested seeds are not exact-state causal branches; two blocks only descriptive
Ki0.15 from clean floor is deferred, not stacked with intervention
Tracking gain does not establish lower slip/vibration/contact risk
The fixed common sign oracle is not a tuned optimum or a learned predictor
